items.title: Special termination right due to price increase (§ 57 Abs. 1 TKG)
items.quote: Weil die Preisanpassung für Sie nachteilig ist, dürfen Sie den Vertrag nach § 57 Abs. 1 TKG außerordentlich kündigen – ohne Kosten und ohne Frist, innerhalb von drei Monaten, nachdem Ihnen diese Mitteilung zugegangen ist.
items.computation: The letter is dated Monday, 19.04.2027, and sent by ordinary post; the sender is a private company, not an authority, so no statutory delivery-fiction (like § 122 AO / § 41 VwVfG) applies. The actual date of receipt (Zugang) is not stated. Absent better evidence, a typical postal transit time of about 3 days is assumed, giving an estimated Zugang on 22.04.2027 (today). The three-month period runs 'nachdem... zugegangen ist', i.e. it is an event-triggered period under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (the day of Zugang itself is not counted) combined with § 188 Abs. 2 BGB (a period of months ends with expiry of the day of the last month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event). The day of the event is 22.04.2027, so the three-month period ends on 22.07.2027. That date is a Thursday, not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday, so § 193 BGB does not extend it further.

warnings: The exact date the letter actually reached the recipient (Zugang) is not stated; a 3-day postal transit time was assumed to compute the deadline for the special termination right, so the resulting due date (2027-07-22) is an estimate and should be corrected if the actual delivery date is known (e.g. from an envelope postmark).
